Name: 2sober's Pokemon for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions for 2sober's Pokemon mods ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10969]Snowlax Farm[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9402]Psyduck Pet Replacement[/url]) were open so I've taken the liberty of updating them all to be their own stand-alone barn animals! This mod adds 6 Pokemon to your barns and they'll produce various fruits for you.

Enjoy!

Manifest.Name: Slowlax Farm
Manifest.Description: Adds barn animals with Slowpoke, Slowbro, Slowking, Munchlax, Snorlax.
